definitions.gloss: policy; measure; initiative; plan of action
definitions.explanation: A concrete plan or action taken by a government, organization, or company to address a problem or achieve a goal. More specific and action-oriented than 政策 (broad policy direction).

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{施策|しさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{出|だ}す→打ち出す：06790_uchidasu⟧。
⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{施策|しさく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少子化|しょうしか}→少子化：04807_shoushika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧さまざまな{施策|しさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}している→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧。
examples.english: The government is considering various measures to address the declining birthrate.

notes: Often confused with ⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧ (policy). {施策|しさく} refers to specific measures or actions taken to implement a broader policy, while ⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧ refers to the overall policy direction. Also distinct from the homophone ⟦{思索|しさく}→思索：15686_shisaku⟧ (contemplation). Common collocations: {施策|しさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{講|こう}じる→講じる：27841_koujiru⟧ (to take measures), {施策|しさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{出|だ}す→打ち出す：06790_uchidasu⟧ (to put forward an initiative), {施策|しさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{推進|すいしん}する→推進する：17281_suishinsuru⟧ (to promote measures).
